transformations.name: whitespace_trimming
transformations.description: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from string columns

transformations.name: null_value_normalization
transformations.description: Normalize string null representations ('null', 'None', 'N/A', '') to standard SQL NULL

transformations.name: type_coercion
transformations.description: Coerce id to string, raw_data to string, and parse cleaned_at to UTC timestamp

transformations.name: record_deduplication
transformations.description: Deduplicate records by key 'id', keeping the most recent valid record

transformations.name: quarantine_invalid_records
transformations.description: Quarantine records with missing or empty 'id' and enforce circuit breaker threshold
transformations.filter_condition: id is not null and trim(id) != ''

transformations.name: ingestion_timestamp
transformations.description: Append ingested_at UTC timestamp to target schema
